The lady gp is useless and lazy, forgets to book referrals and always wants to make appointments quick. Dr Sami (the lady gp) doesnt even let patients finish explaining what is wrong with them before coming to a conclusion - which is always a change of diet. Patronising service throughout, from the reception to the gp. There seems to be ethnical favouritism going on in there, English seems like a 5th language in this practice. Look at the names of every 5 star review- that speaks for itself. Front desk does not care about where patients sit or what they do. There are patients speaking very loud in ethnic languages and staff does not care - even joining in at times and making others uncomfortable. Blood tests take weeks, even then you have to call in multiple times to get results. I have suffered with nerve pain for 10 years - all they have told me is to go to physiotherapy constantly and lose weight (I am a 70kg male at 5'9). They also told me that it is fine to take 2 strong painkillers every night for the rest of my life to manage my pain. My father had an extremely important appointment after suffering heart complications - to which they kept forgetting to book and then blamed him. It was completely different when Dr Botros was there. Seems like me and my family will have to find a new gp and I suggest you do the same.
